sources.title: NASA POWER Daily API
sources.temporal_coverage: Daily records from 1981 to near real time; exact retrieved period is shown with each response.
sources.spatial_scope: Point requests return gridded data; native spatial resolution varies by parameter.
limitations: Historical or near-real-time observations are not a future weather forecast.
Gridded climate data do not measure conditions inside an individual farm plot.
The application must show the exact retrieved period and missing-data quality.

sources.title: FAO ECOCROP crop database
sources.publisher: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations
sources.temporal_coverage: Crop reference records; record-specific validity dates are not consistently supplied.
sources.spatial_scope: General crop-level references, not plot-level or Long Xuyen-specific measurements.
limitations: General crop envelopes do not establish a local planting calendar.
Annual rainfall ranges must not be compared directly with a short seasonal rainfall total.
Use crop-specific records and retain missing values where a record is incomplete.

sources.title: FAO Crop Water Needs guidance
sources.publisher: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations
fields: crop coefficient by growth stage where published
indicative crop water needs where published
sources.temporal_coverage: Reference guidance; crop values are not tied to a specific year.
sources.spatial_scope: General agronomic guidance; not calibrated to a specific Long Xuyen field.
limitations: Crop coefficients depend on local humidity, wind, crop stage and management.
Do not transfer coefficients between different crop species without a source that supports the transfer.
Crop evapotranspiration is not the same as irrigation demand or field water availability.

sources.title: SoilGrids global soil information
sources.temporal_coverage: Global modeled soil products; prediction vintage must be reported when available.
sources.spatial_scope: Global predictions at 250 m, with coarser aggregated products also available.
limitations: Predictions include uncertainty and are not a soil sample from the user's plot.
SoilGrids does not provide soil electrical conductivity in its published basic property list.
Do not infer soil salinity or irrigation-water salinity from SoilGrids.

sources.title: Digital salinity maps for crop and forecasted vulnerable areas in the Mekong River Delta
sources.publisher: Southern Institute of Water Resources Research and CGIAR Initiative on Asian Mega-Deltas
sources.temporal_coverage: 2024 report and associated map product; use the product vintage shown in its metadata.
sources.spatial_scope: Mekong River Delta at district level, not an individual field.
limitations: The repository identifies the report review status as internal review.
Use as regional risk context only; it cannot replace field soil or irrigation-water EC measurements.
Forecasted vulnerable areas in the source product are not a weather forecast for this application.

sources.title: An Giang 2026–2027 winter–spring rice planting schedule notice
sources.publisher: People's Committee of Nhon My Commune, citing An Giang Department of Agriculture and Environment
sources.spatial_scope: An Giang production zones named in the notice; not a general crop calendar for all coordinates.
limitations: This notice concerns rice and must not be applied to soybean, maize or mung bean.
The calendar is season-specific and must not be reused as a permanent annual rule.
Local authorities may adjust timing based on water and field conditions.
